html: I’m very happy to be able to announce that Brilliance Audio has secured MacLeod Andrews as the audiobook actor for Once Dead.  I was extremely pleased with the fine work he did bringing the Rho Agenda trilogy to life and it is a pleasure to have him on board again.

comments.author: pinknightmare21
comments.html: Please inform Mr. Andrews on the proper pronunciation of SIPERNET. He is a great narrator 🙂

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
That’s funny. It’s about the only real error I noticed him make. I think he’s fabulous as well and I’ll pass it along through my publisher to the audiobook editor at Brilliance Audio although I’m not sure how close they are to final on Once Dead.
Richard

comments.author: codepunk
comments.html: I travel 1 day a week from Camas, WA to Seattle which is 3 hours one way. Needless to say I listen to a lot of audio books. You’re Rho trilogy has been the best so far. Absolutely love it. Reminds of the movie Chronicle 🙂 Almost finished with the last book. Can’t wait for my drive to Seattle on Tuesday. I might have to drive extra slow.

replies.author: Richard Phillips
replies.html:
Thanks Mark. I’m glad you enjoy the audiobooks. I think McLeod Andrews has done a fabulous job again on the Once Dead audiobook scheduled for release on 19 August.
Richard
